action.objective: Win the g6 bishop with Nxg6, opening Black's kingside and consolidating material.
action.rationale: e5g6 (Nxg6) is the only commit-ready move. Single-candidate verification at completed depth 3 gave exact score 241 with PV Nxg6 Rg8, and safety checks show no immediate mate (not_found for checking-reply refutation, no forced mate). Nxg6 wins the light-squared bishop outright; if Black recaptures hxg6, Qxg6 hits f5/d5 and Black's king is exposed. Broad search at depth 2 also rated Nxg6 highest (302). The alternative lines were upper-bounded and unverified. Commit the verified capture.
